say:2:1033343001:1.text: Not much. From time to time, peddlers would come here and purchase goods.
say:2:1033343001:1.source_cn: 不多，但偶尔会有行商来采购进货。
say:2:1033343001:1.male: Not much. From time to time, peddlers would come here and purchase goods.
say:2:1033343001:1.female: Not much. From time to time, peddlers would come here and purchase goods.

say:3:1033343002:1.text: Thanks to your blessing, Misarte, plant-based goods from the Dark Forest are widely recognized. The quality of them outshine those of any other locale.
say:3:1033343002:1.source_cn: 受弥萨忒庇佑，薄暮丛林的植物制品效用远超其他地方出产的...
say:3:1033343002:1.male: Thanks to your blessing, Misarte, plant-based goods from the Dark Forest are widely recognized. The quality of them outshine those of any other locale.
say:3:1033343002:1.female: Thanks to your blessing, Misarte, plant-based goods from the Dark Forest are widely recognized. The quality of them outshine those of any other locale.

say:4:1033343003:1.text: We would also accept commissions from some traveling peddlers, gathering herbs and curing spices for them in advance.
say:4:1033343003:1.source_cn: 我们会接受一些外来行商的委托，提前替他们采集草药、熏制香料。
say:4:1033343003:1.male: We would also accept commissions from some traveling peddlers, gathering herbs and curing spices for them in advance.
say:4:1033343003:1.female: We would also accept commissions from some traveling peddlers, gathering herbs and curing spices for them in advance.

say:5:1033343004:1.text: Look. It's all piling up here... and no one can come and take them away.
say:5:1033343004:1.source_cn: 你看，积攒了这么多……可已经没人来取了。
say:5:1033343004:1.male: Look. It's all piling up here... and no one can come and take them away.
say:5:1033343004:1.female: Look. It's all piling up here... and no one can come and take them away.
